messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Error when running 8 schools example
parts:
Does anyone have any ideas? It looks like we haven't responded
to this message. I don't know much about the R interface with
the C++ tool chain.

Kevin: which C++ tools are you using? Stan won't compile
with versions of g++ that are too old. Can you open a terminal
and do "g++ --version" and report the result? (I'm not sure
how to find g++ on Windows, though I'd expect it to be on your PATH
if the line below is going to work, but I'm not very Windows-savvy.)

I'm also not sure what's going on with bit size, but it looks like
you/R may be mixing 32-bit (-m32 option) and 64-bit (extralibs64)
builds. If you have a 64-bit machine, I'd recommend using a 64-bit
build throughout. For 32-bit builds, some extra fiddling may be required
on optimization levels for Windows (which has a tendency to blow out
memory on 32-bit builds).

- Bob
